repos_data.description: Applications of Monte Carlo methods to financial engineering projects, in Python.
A short and easy implementation of Quantile Regression DQN | Distributional Reinforcement Learning
High-fidelity synthetic financial data generator using Heston Stochastic Volatility and Jump Diffusion.

Scores hedgeable concentrated-liquidity pools by a spike-resistant fee floor with real CL impermanent-loss math, then backtests pool rotation against the no-lookahead ex-ante benchmark. Keyless, Python stdlib only.

The first end-to-end C++20 implementation of special-relativistic geometry applied to financial OHLCV data. Computes Lorentz factors, spacetime intervals, Christoffel symbols, and geodesic deviation signals from live market data.

Distributional crypto-return forecasting via Wasserstein-geodesic extrapolation in quantile-function space. WGeo family wins 12/12 (asset × horizon) cells over 6.75y walk-forward CRPS vs GARCH and classical baselines. v0.4.
